## Test artifact
Link to compiled `.jar` / `.mcpack` from CI artifacts.

## Test command
`/cosmetics test `

## Checklist
- [ ] Shape clean from front, side, back (F5)
- [ ] Does not obstruct first-person camera
- [ ] Sprint/jump/spin — math rotates cleanly with yaw
- [ ] 10s looping preview GIF recorded
- [ ] MSPT/TPS within budget
